metadata.description: Unique name for the Web App.
The secret token for GraphQL Dashboard authentication.
Initial root token for Vault (Dev Mode).

variables.composePart1:
version: '3.8'
services:
  openlobster:
    image: ghcr.io/neirth/openlobster/openlobster:latest
    environment:
      - OPENLOBSTER_GRAPHQL_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - OPENLOBSTER_GRAPHQL_AUTH_TOKEN=
variables.composePart5:
networks:
      - app-net
  neo4j:
    image: neo4j:5-community
    environment:
      - NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/
variables.composePart6:
networks:
      - app-net
  vault:
    image: hashicorp/vault:latest
    environment:
      - VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID=
variables.composePart7:
- VAULT_ADDR=http://0.0.0.0:8200
    networks:
      - app-net
networks:
  app-net:
    driver: bridge
variables.fullCompose: [concat(variables('composePart1'), parameters('openlobsterAuthToken'), variables('composePart2'), parameters('neo4jPassword'), variables('composePart3'), parameters('vaultRootToken'), variables('composePart4'), parameters('openaiApiKey'), variables('composePart5'), parameters('neo4jPassword'), variables('composePart6'), parameters('vaultRootToken'), variables('composePart7'))]
